category.name: Music generation
category.description: Generate songs, instrumentals, loops and sound effects from prompts.

entries.name: Beatoven.ai API
entries.desc_en: Generate royalty-cleared background music and sound effects from text prompts via REST API (Maestro).
entries.notes: Auth and endpoints are documented in the public API spec on GitHub (Beatoven/public-api); free-credit amount is not disclosed on public pages.

async_jobs.how: POST /api/v1/tracks/compose returns task_id; poll GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} until status 'composed'

call.async: Poll GET https://public-api.beatoven.ai/api/v1/tasks/{task_id} until status = composed; the track URL is meta.track_url (stems in meta.stems_url).
call.operation: compose a music track from a text prompt

entries.name: ElevenLabs Music API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 10,000 credits per month shared with TTS (music included, no commercial use of music on Free; Starter $6/mo or higher needed)
entries.desc_en: Generate original music tracks from text prompts or detailed composition plans via REST API, with commercial licensing.
entries.notes: Endpoint POST /v1/music; models music_v1/v2/v2.5; billed from the same ElevenLabs credit pool as TTS. Hosted OAuth MCP at api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp; the elevenlabs-mcp repo is archived since 2026-08-20.

free_plan.quota: 10k credits (music included, no commercial use on free plan)

rate_limits.summary: Concurrency-based: Free plan 2 concurrent requests (TTS figures; higher on paid plans)

async_jobs.how: POST /v1/music returns the generated audio file directly

call.operation: generate a music track from a text prompt
call.example: curl -X POST "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/music?output_format=mp3_44100_128" -H "xi-api-key: $ELEVENLABS_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"Upbeat lo-fi hip hop with warm piano","music_length_ms":30000}' --output track.mp3

unit_price.summary: Music generation $0.15 per minute of generated audio (API, all paid tiers); finetune $1.50 each

entries.name: Loudly API
entries.free_tier: Trial: free track allowance on signup with the API key from the developer portal; then volume-based pricing (Startup/SME/Corporate) or pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate, remix, stem-split, and master music tracks programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Vendor lists an MCP server as 'in development' (not yet released) as of this check.

async_jobs.how: POST /api/ai/prompt/songs returns a song object with the generated track

call.operation: generate a song from a text prompt
call.example: curl -X POST https://soundtracks.loudly.com/api/ai/prompt/songs -H "API-KEY: $LOUDLY_API_KEY" -F "prompt=Upbeat lo-fi hip hop with warm piano" -F "duration=30"

entries.name: Mubert API
entries.auth_hint: customer-id + access-token headers (credentials emailed after checkout)
entries.free_tier: paid only; plans start at $49/mo (100 generations/mo), no free tier
entries.desc_en: Generate streaming or file-based background music from text/image prompts via REST/WebRTC API, 15s-25min tracks.
entries.notes: No self-serve free trial; must purchase a plan before receiving API credentials.

async_jobs.how: POST /tracks, then poll GET track by id or use a webhook

call.async: Generation is asynchronous: poll GET https://music-api.mubert.com/api/v3/public/tracks/{TRACK_ID} until generations[].url is set (URLs expire), or enable a webhook on the license.

entries.name: Soundraw API
entries.auth_hint: check docs (exact header not publicly disclosed on marketing pages)
entries.free_tier: Trial: one-time 2-week free API trial with no commitment; then Starter $29.99/mo for 100 songs with a 6-month minimum commitment
entries.desc_en: Generate royalty-free background music tracks by mood, genre, and duration via REST API for embedding in apps.
entries.notes: Full technical API reference is gated behind sales/docs portal; only an FAQ page and pricing were publicly confirmed.

unit_price.summary: API Starter $29.99/mo for up to 100 songs (~$0.30 per song); API Pro $300/mo for up to 1,000 songs

entries.name: Stable Audio API (Stability AI)
entries.free_tier: shares Stability AI platform credits; 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate music and sound effects from text prompts via REST API (Stable Audio 2.5, or Stable Audio 3.0 for tracks up to 6 minutes).
entries.notes: Endpoint POST /v2beta/audio/stable-audio-2/text-to-audio; default model 2.5 costs 20 credits per generation; Stable Audio 3.0 (up to 6 min, async) costs 26 credits. Shares the platform.stability.ai credit system with Stability's image API.

free_plan.quota: 25 free credits for new accounts (Stable Audio 2.5 costs 20 credits per generation)

rate_limits.summary: 150 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding gives 429 and a 60-second timeout

async_jobs.how: POST /v2beta/audio/stable-audio-2/text-to-audio returns audio directly; GET /v2beta/audio/results/{id} exists for async generations

call.operation: generate music or sound effects from a text prompt
call.example: curl -f -sS https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/audio/stable-audio-2/text-to-audio -H "authorization: Bearer $STABILITY_API_KEY" -H "accept: audio/*" -F prompt="Upbeat acoustic guitar with light drums and claps" -F output_format=mp3 -F duration=20 -F model=stable-audio-2.5 -o output.mp3

unit_price.summary: Stable Audio 2.5 text-to-audio: 20 credits per successful generation; 1 credit = $0.01 (about $0.20)
